meta.titleSignedOut: Sign in to My ADA | Asian Doula Alliance

signIn.title: Sign in to My ADA
signIn.lead: For ADA doulas and exam candidates. See your credentials and exam results, and download your certificates.
signIn.doulaIdHint: It is on your ADA certificate and in emails from ADA, for example {example}.
signIn.emailHint: The email where ADA sends your exam and certificate messages.
signIn.phoneLabel: Phone number on your ADA record
signIn.phoneHint: The mobile number ADA has on file for you.
signIn.note: There is no password. ADA checks your Doula ID against the email or phone number on your record.

errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.noMatch: We could not match that Doula ID with that {method, select, email {email} other {phone number}}. Check both and try again.
errors.failed: Sign-in did not work. Please try again.

who.title: Who uses My ADA
who.doulasBody: See your credentials and exam results, and download your certificate PDFs.
who.familiesBody: You do not need an account to check a doula. The registry is free and public.
who.staffBody: Staff do not use My ADA. Sign in to the admin with your staff account.

trouble.title: Can’t sign in?
trouble.idBody: It is on your ADA certificate and in emails from ADA.
trouble.methodBody: If your email does not match, choose Phone and enter the number on your record, or the other way round.
trouble.askBody: Email {email} or call {phone} with your full name and Doula ID.
trouble.photoAlt: A trainee in the ADA Postpartum Doula Program practises a newborn hold with a training doll
trouble.photoCaption: A trainee practises a newborn hold in the ADA Postpartum Doula Program. {date}.

standing.title: Your standing
standing.bodyActive: {count, plural, =0 {Your ADA record is active. No credential is active yet.} one {Your ADA record is active. You hold # active ADA credential.} other {Your ADA record is active. You hold # active ADA credentials.}}
standing.bodyRegistered: You are registered with ADA. Your credentials appear here once ADA issues them.
standing.bodyReview: ADA is reviewing your record. Contact ADA with any questions.
standing.bodyOther: Contact ADA about the status of your record.

cta.renew: Renew before your {credential} credential expires on {date}.

credentials.title: Your credentials and certificates
credentials.caption: Credentials and certificates held by {name}, Doula ID {id}
credentials.footnote: *Each number opens your public record in the ADA registry.
credentials.empty: No credentials or certificates on file yet.
credentials.downloadLabel: Download the {credential} certificate, {number}, as a PDF
credentials.expiresInDays: {days, plural, one {Expires in # day} other {Expires in # days}}
credentials.expiresInMonths: {months, plural, one {Expires in # month} other {Expires in # months}}
credentials.expiresInYears: Expires in {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}{months, plural, =0 {} one {, # month} other {, # months}}

results.title: Your exam results
results.caption: Scores by area for exam session {session}

profile.title: Profile
profile.note: To update your information, contact ADA at {email} or {phone}.

help.title: Help
help.renewDesc: Each credential is valid for {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}. Renewal is {fee}.
help.conductDesc: The standards every ADA-certified doula agrees to.
help.registryDesc: Look up an ADA doula by name, Doula ID or certificate number.
